description: Tests failing on main@a6a377a, pinned deliberately (S0.4). Recorded by ASSERTION IDENTITY, not by name: both failures are stale source strings, so a same-named failure with different asserted literals is a NEW failure and the delta gate must say so.

failing.name: a page size is declared and the grid is sliced by it
failing.known_cause: Stale source string. `const PAGE_SIZE = 9;` still matches (podcast.tsx:19); the second assertion greps for "visible.slice(1, 1 + shown)" and the file now slices as "gridEpisodes.slice(0, shown)" (podcast.tsx:102) after mobile pagination was added. The behaviour is present; the literal is not. Repaired in Phase 7 (S0.4b).

failing.suite: row keys are defined and unique
failing.name: the card is keyed on slug.current, never on the dropped guid
failing.known_cause: Stale source string. The test asserts podcast.tsx contains "key={row.source.slug.current}"; the file has said "key={episode.slug.current}" (podcast.tsx:240) since a bot commit reshaped the grid. The invariant the test was written to protect — cards keyed on slug.current, never on the dropped guid — still holds; only the literal it greps for is stale. Repaired in Phase 7, not here (S0.4b).
